name: manual_b37924
claim: In skill and reference text under bin/orama-system do not write literal dotenv file names even in a prohibition; the agent-surface scan flags them as HIGH. Say environment-variable files or local environment files, and rewrap to the 100-column markdown rule.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: the orama agent-surface scan (aguara) failed a PR with one HIGH finding, CRED_021 dotenv file exposure, on prose that merely named dotenv files in a prohibition. The same doc's existing safety table already says environment-variable files for this reason.
